intro: Before is vanilla Skyrim on your own. After is our co-op setup.

grids.title: Single player, before and after
rows: Everyone keeps their own save. The server holds no copy. Save often; never reload while connected.
One party leader for the whole playthrough handles quest people, scenes and quest items, and enters places first. Everyone fights bosses and solves puzzles.
Finish Helgen or Helgen Express offline, save outside, then connect.
Nothing pauses. Get out of danger before opening menus.
You respawn nearby, or at the entrance indoors. No gold lost. Crime bounties still apply.
Master for everyone, set by the server. Enemies do not scale with party size.
Players can't hurt players. Followers and townsfolk can still be hurt.
Combat experience is shared. Crafting experience is not.
A smaller-party night uses separate characters.
Voice, or text chat: F2 or Right Ctrl, type, Enter. /party and /local work.

grids.title: Skills, before and after
rows: Penetration, poison, stagger. HOLD: the whole Steady Hand branch.
Strong Reflexes rank 1 allowed. HOLD: rank 2.
One active summon per player. HOLD: raising corpses.
Regeneration. Resurgence healing on friends not tested yet.
Utility. HOLD: spectral drum and merchant powers.

grids.title: Races, before and after
rows: Swimming, recovery, Caustic Spit. Co-op not tested yet.
Hunting. HOLD: Beast Tongue. Harrier not tested yet.
Magic defense. Borrowed powers follow the same holds.
Ancestor traits. HOLD: Spirit Walk. Whispers not tested yet.
Discipline is not healing; player aura not tested yet.
Stealth. Prowl leaps, it does not teleport. Co-op not tested yet.
Frost defense; offense when injured; Avatar recovery.
Travel stamina. HOLD: Red Sand Dance.

grids.title: Spells, before and after
grids.note: Our spell mod is Mysticism, not Apocalypse.
rows: Adds enemy debuffs. HOLD: Mark and Recall.
More summons, including skeletons. One active summon per player. HOLD: raising corpses.
More progression and drain spells, such as Vampiric Bolt and Blood Lance.
More choices. Enemy-control spells can't control players.
More support. Start with Healing Hands, Heal Other and Grand Healing.

grids.title: What we can't use yet, before and after
grids.note: Held until we test them together. The full list is on Can I use this?
rows: Teleport back to a marked spot
Raise the dead to fight for you
Hold. One active summon per player instead.

grids.title: A night of play, before and after
rows: Launch Skyrim Together, load your campaign save, press F2, Connect with the host's private details, join the leader's party, type READY.
Join the party and regroup. Don't quest alone to catch up.
Type HOLD or BRB and get somewhere safe. Nothing pauses.
Get safe. Save and let it finish. F2, Disconnect, Proceed, then quit.
Save if possible. Let it finish. Press F2, choose Disconnect, then Proceed. Quit the game. Quitting may still crash; no fix is proven.
Stop and tell the host. Never reload while connected or fix quests alone.

grids.title: Builds, before and after
rows: Restoration first, plus personal defense. A paladin switches between shield, weapon and healing.
Greatsword, Heavy Armor and Block make space. Turn to protect a chased friend.
Archery and Sneak find the opening. Keep moving and shooting after you're spotted.
Destruction and Alteration for fire and protection, backup Restoration. Earn a staff later.
Restoration first, Conjuration second. One summoned helper buys healing time.
Speech, Restoration and a weapon. Keep a reliable damage fallback.

grids.title: Group play, before and after
rows: Say "On me". Move toward the group; the frontliner steps in.
Say "Healing here" and come within reach. Healing is not resurrection.
Say "Caster first" and focus it. Keep a retreat route open.
Everyone uses matching mods. Agree on changes together.

grids.title: Ownership, before and after
rows: Yours. Offer upgrades before selling. The leader takes quest items.
Yours. No shared purse. No gold lost on death; crime fines still apply.
Home chests stay on your own save. Test your exact chest with a cheap item, save and rejoin first.
Meeting places, not banks. Empty rooms before renovating.
Not tested yet. Try one cheap item in an unowned chest outside a home, then both save and rejoin. Never trade by dropping items.
Do the quest, pay the steward
The leader does the quests; buy from the steward. Payments by non-leaders are not tested yet.
Plots cost 5,000 gold before building. Building together is not tested yet.

grids.title: Our mods, before and after
grids.note: The base mods that run the server (Skyrim Together, SKSE, Address Library) are not listed. The last three are in our next collection revision.
rows: A quick start screen: pick race, sign, gear, spells and helper.
Sortable menus and the Mod Configuration menu.
Menus don't pause. You can be hit while in your bag.
Borderless window, higher frame rates, cursor stays in the game.
Enemies commit to swings, so you can sidestep and punish.
Real weapon hitboxes. Wide swings hit several enemies.
Modern movement. Middle mouse locks onto hostiles; scroll switches target.
Walk up and press E on what's highlighted.
Precision, TDM and other menus appear in Mod Configuration.
Health bars over enemies and a boss bar.
A loot list pops up beside chests and bodies. E takes one, R takes all.
Shows known enchantments, read books, value and weight.
Every school reworked, many new spells. See Spells above.
New powers and passives for every race. See Races above.
Every perk tree reworked. See Skills above.
